content.json:
## 대출 여정 운영 지표
합성 데이터 기준. 신청 단위 연결은 `application_id`로 합니다(Durable 오케스트레이터 → 활동 트레이스 미연결).

content.title: 단계별 결과·p95 소요(ms)
content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message == "journey.step"
| extend step = tostring(Properties.step), outcome = tostring(Properties.outcome), ms = todouble(Properties.duration_ms)
| summarize total = count(), ok = countif(outcome == "ok"), degraded = countif(outcome == "degraded"), failed = countif(outcome == "failed"), p95_ms = percentile(ms, 95) by step
| extend ok_rate = round(100.0 * ok / total, 1)
| order by step asc

content.title: 의존성 실패(대상별)
content.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName in ("orchestrator", "policy")
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(Success == false) by Target, AppRoleName
| order by failed desc

content.title: Policy 서킷 상태
content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message == "policy.circuit"
| project TimeGenerated, state = tostring(Properties.state), AppRoleInstance
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: 토큰 추이(시간별)
content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message == "journey.step"
| summarize input_tokens = sum(tolong(Properties.input_tokens)), output_tokens = sum(tolong(Properties.output_tokens)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

content.title: 신청 1건의 스팬
content.query:
let ops = union AppRequests, AppDependencies | where tostring(Properties.application_id) == "{ApplicationId}" | distinct OperationId;
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where OperationId in (ops)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationId, Name, Target, DurationMs, Success, AppRoleName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
